english.title: Supply false information to another knowing it is to be given to OFCOM etc under the Enterprise Act 2002
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied information to **(..SPECIFY OTHER PERSON..) which you knew was false or misleading in a material respect, or recklessly supplied information which was false or misleading in a material respect, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE MISLEADING INFORMATION..) knowing that the information was to be used for the purpose of supplying information to the

(A)_[FCOM,]_
(B)_[CMA,]_
(C)_[Secretary of State,]_

in connection with functions under Part 3 of the Enterprise Act 2002
english.legislation: Contrary to section117(2) and (3) of the Enterprise Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date and place
supplied information to another
which you knew was false or misleading in a material respect/recklessly supplied information which was false in a material respect
knowing that the information was to be used for the purpose of supplying information
to OFCOM/CMA/Secretary of State
in connection with its/his functions under Part 3 of the Enterprise Act 2002

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 1st April 2014. For the offence applying before this date, see H6814.
(ii) A person does not commit an offence under subsection (2) by reason of any act or omission if the appropriate authority has proceeded against the person under section 110(1) or (1A) in relation to that act or omission (section 117(2A)).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and /or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

As the offence came into force after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
